definitions.gloss: sadness; sorrow; how sad something is
definitions.explanation: The noun form of {悲|かな}しい. It names sadness as a quality or a degree — how sad a thing or an experience is — rather than the emotion in the abstract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悲|かな}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt the sadness of parting.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{悲|かな}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That song has a sadness that words cannot capture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悲|かな}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Those around them can hardly understand the sorrow of someone who has lost their family.

notes:
Formed by replacing the final い of ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧ with さ, the regular way to make a noun of degree from an i-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲|かな}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel sadness
- {悲|かな}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こみ{上|あ}げる: sadness wells up
- {悲|かな}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to bear the sorrow
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{悲|かな}しさ: indescribable sadness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧: sorrow, grief — the emotion itself, deeper and more lasting; the usual choice for grief over a death
- {寂|さび}しさ: loneliness — the ache of being alone rather than of loss
